task_semantics.functional_part: marker tip or writing end region that should touch and trace the visible line
task_semantics.contact_point: tip endpoint/contact point matched to the visible line start and use-stage path
task_semantics.motion_axis: marker body or shaft axis used to orient the whole marker along or naturally relative to the trace direction

evidence.publish_policy: Use configs/tool_refs/staples_marker as the publishable tool-ref evidence package; historical runtime evidence paths remain provenance only.

review_questions: Which part marker is the actual writing tip or writing end for trace contact?
Which face/contact marker should be point-matched to the visible line?
Which marker shaft/body face or axis should be used for motion-axis alignment?
Should visible produced ink overlap be required for task success or kept diagnostic-only?
What numeric tolerances should gate tip-to-line distance, endpoint error, and contact continuity?
review_notes: Switched from sharpie_marker because the previewed sharpie asset appears capped in topdown evidence.

evidence_provenance.publish_policy: Historical runtime evidence paths are provenance only and are intentionally omitted from publishable configs.
